fit.title: Use your demo to verify the workflow
fit.body: Use this practical checklist to compare the systems you are considering on the work your team performs every day.
fit.booking.body: Create, move and complete a booking; check staff, duration, chair, waitlist and status handling.
fit.checkout.body: Build a bill, review GST and complete a UPI/card/cash/wallet split payment.
fit.client.body: Open history, preferences, wallet, loyalty, notes and follow-up context.
fit.stock.body: Trace purchase, batch, expiry, service usage, waste and reorder context.
fit.staff.body: Review attendance, shift, commission, incentive and payroll workflow.
fit.branch.body: Confirm branch-scoped access, records and owner visibility for authorised locations.
fit.note: Ask every vendor to demonstrate these tasks with real product behaviour and disclose any integration or configuration required.
